[EN] The state of this place, with all the corpses lined up, speaks volumes about the miserable lives the sub-devan slaves have.

This particular corpse is still clutching an old and dirty kerchief, with something carefully wrapped up inside.
[ES] El estado de este lugar, con todos los cadáveres alineados, dice mucho sobre las míseras vidas que llevan los esclavos sub-devan.

Este cadáver en particular aún aferra un pañuelo viejo y sucio, con algo envuelto cuidadosamente en su interior.

[EN] Inside the dirty kercheif there is a single piece of stale bread...clearly once someone's most treasured possession.What's in here?You held onto it...you can keep it.
[ES] Dentro del pañuelo sucio hay un solo trozo de pan duro... claramente alguna vez la posesión más preciada de alguien.What's in here?You held onto it...you can keep it.
